name: Source code / 源码获取
text:
--- SOURCE-CODE.md ---
# 源码获取 / Source code

ADM 自有代码以 MIT 许可提供：https://github.com/ruishanio/adm 。第三方组件保持各自许可。

## MPL 2.0 组件

本目录 `sources/` 随应用附带以下未经修改的原始 crates.io 源码归档：

- cssparser 0.37.0
- cssparser-macros 0.7.1（过程宏，保守归档）
- dtoa-short 0.3.5
- option-ext 0.2.0
- selectors 0.38.0

`.crate` 是 gzip 压缩的 tar 源码包，可用 `tar -xzf 文件名.crate` 解压。
版本、原始下载地址和 SHA-256 见 `sources.json`；摘要与 `Cargo.lock` 校验一致。
这些源码继续按 MPL 2.0 提供。源码的获取与修改权不受 ADM 的 MIT 许可或第三方运行时条款限制。

macOS：Finder 中对 ADM.app 选择「显示包内容」，进入 `Contents/Resources/legal/sources/`。
Windows：ADM 安装目录或便携版目录中的 `legal/sources/`。
仓库中也保留同样的归档，不依赖临时 GitHub Actions 产物存储。

Unmodified source archives for the five MPL-2.0 components listed above accompany
this application in `legal/sources/` (macOS: `Contents/Resources/legal/sources/`).
These `.crate` files are gzip-compressed tar archives. Exact upstream URLs and
SHA-256 hashes matching Cargo.lock are in `sources.json`. The covered source
remains available under MPL 2.0; other terms do not restrict those source rights.

## 其他组件

`catalog.json` 和 `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` 列出 npm/crates.io 的精确版本源码地址，
原始许可和版权声明。Rust 清单保守覆盖两个平台的依赖解析结果，包含构建工具和宏，
不表示所有清单代码都进入可执行文件。标准库声明也包含本应用未启用的平台和功能。
多重许可原文均予保留；AND 义务不会被单个 MIT 标题替代。

## ADB 分发核对尚未完成

ADB 来自 Google 官方 Platform-Tools 37.0.1，build 15733141。对应压缩包的 SHA-256
固定在 `scripts/package_ci.py`。官方 NOTICE 未改动，随 platform-tools 和本许可目录交付。
开发参考源码：https://android.googlesource.com/platform/packages/modules/adb/ 。

该链接不是此二进制的完整对应源码证明。静态包含的 libusb 涉及 LGPL 2.1，仍需取得
与二进制对应的源代码、构建说明和重新链接材料，或采用经过核实的其他合规分发方式。
目前不提供无法兑现的源码书面要约，也不宣称仅有 NOTICE 就完成了这部分义务。
发布核对状态见 `release-review.json`；待办未关闭时自动产物上传会中止。

ADB source/relinking review is pending. The AOSP development repository is not
proof of source correspondence for Google's prebuilt build 15733141. Its bundled
libusb requires further LGPL compliance work. This document is not a source-code
offer and does not assert that the original NOTICE alone satisfies that work.

name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
text:
--- WINDOWS-RUNTIME.txt ---
Windows runtime notice / Windows 运行时说明

ADM 的自有代码按 MIT 许可提供；Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime 是独立的
第三方软件，适用微软的许可条款，不因 ADM 的 MIT 许可而被重新授权。
Windows 版本通过 WebView2 显示界面。缺少运行时时，安装程序从微软下载
Evergreen Bootstrapper；运行时可自动更新。

本软件使用的 WebView2 包含 Microsoft Defender SmartScreen，默认启用。
SmartScreen 会收集用户的信息并发送给微软，具体见微软隐私声明和
Microsoft Edge 隐私白皮书。WebView2 也可能向微软发送诊断数据。
这些行为由微软运行时及系统策略控制，不表示 ADM 将 Android 设备文件
上传给微软。ADM 未关闭 SmartScreen 安全保护。

Microsoft Privacy Statement / 微软隐私声明:
https://aka.ms/privacy
Microsoft Edge Privacy Whitepaper — SmartScreen:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/privacy-whitepaper#smartscreen
WebView2 data and privacy / 数据与隐私:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/concepts/data-privacy

ADM original code is licensed under MIT. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is
separate software governed by Microsoft's license terms, not ADM's MIT license.
The Windows edition uses WebView2 to display its interface. When the runtime is
missing, the installer downloads the Evergreen Bootstrapper from Microsoft.
The runtime can update automatically.

This software uses WebView2, which includes Microsoft Defender SmartScreen,
enabled by default. SmartScreen collects and sends end-user information to
Microsoft as disclosed in the Microsoft Privacy Statement and the Microsoft
Edge Privacy Whitepaper linked above. WebView2 may also send diagnostic data
to Microsoft. These behaviors are controlled by the runtime and system policy;
they do not mean ADM uploads Android device files to Microsoft. ADM does not
disable SmartScreen.

Runtime license terms / 运行时许可条款:
https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/
The terms are shown by the official page's Runtime download controls before
acceptance. The runtime and its updates may include additional terms.

WebView2 SDK 1.0.3800.47 and WebView2LoaderStatic.lib are separate from the
Runtime. The SDK's original Microsoft BSD-style license and NOTICE are included
in vendor/webview2-sdk-LICENSE.txt and vendor/webview2-sdk-NOTICE.txt.
The Rust wrappers have their own MIT license entries in the catalog.

## Apple SDKs

These crates are derived from Apple SDKs shipped with Xcode. You can obtain a
copy of the Xcode license at:

https://www.apple.com/legal/sla/docs/xcode.pdf

Or by typing `xcodebuild -license` in your terminal.

From reading the license, it is unclear whether distributing derived works
such as these crates are allowed?

But in any case, to practically use these crates, you will have to link, and
that only works when you have the correct Xcode SDK available to provide the
required `.tbd` files, which is why we choose to still use the normal SPDX
identifiers in the crates (Xcode is required to use the crates, and when using

# License

The licensing of these crates is a bit complicated:
- The crates `objc2`, `block2`, `objc2-foundation` and `objc2-encode` are
  [currently][#23] licensed under [the MIT license][MIT].
- All other crates are trio-licensed under the [Zlib], [Apache-2.0] or [MIT]
  license, at your option.

Furthermore, the crates are (usually automatically) derived from Apple SDKs,
and that may have implications for licensing, see below for details.

[#23]: https://github.com/madsmtm/objc2/issues/23
[MIT]: https://opensource.org/license/MIT
[Zlib]: https://zlib.net/zlib_license.html
[Apache-2.0]: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0


## Apple SDKs

These crates are derived from Apple SDKs shipped with Xcode. You can obtain a
copy of the Xcode license at:

https://www.apple.com/legal/sla/docs/xcode.pdf

Or by typing `xcodebuild -license` in your terminal.

From reading the license, it is unclear whether distributing derived works
such as these crates are allowed?

But in any case, to practically use these crates, you will have to link, and
that only works when you have the correct Xcode SDK available to provide the
required `.tbd` files, which is why we choose to still use the normal SPDX
identifiers in the crates (Xcode is required to use the crates, and when using
Xcode you have already agreed to the Xcode license).

These crates are derived from Apple SDKs shipped with Xcode. You can obtain a
copy of the Xcode license at:

https://www.apple.com/legal/sla/docs/xcode.pdf

Or by typing `xcodebuild -license` in your terminal.

From reading the license, it is unclear whether distributing derived works

that only works when you have the correct Xcode SDK available to provide the
required `.tbd` files, which is why we choose to still use the normal SPDX
identifiers in the crates (Xcode is required to use the crates, and when using
